cleavage agent: digested with sequencing-grade trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C overnight
enrichment method: the supernatant was incubated with anti-FLAG agarose beads at 4 °C for 4 h
instrument: connected to Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher)
labeling: Proteins were disulphide-reduced by 25 mM DTT at 37 °C for 40 min, alkylated by adding 50 mM iodoacetamide, and then digested with sequencing-grade trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C overnight.
reduction reagent: Proteins were disulphide-reduced by 25 mM DTT at 37 °C for 40 min
reduction concentration: Proteins were disulphide-reduced by 25 mM DTT at 37 °C for 40 min
